title: Artificial Intelligence and the Ethics and Practice of Evaluation
summary_en: This chapter argues for engaging with AI ethics before AI-led reasoning becomes institutionally embedded.
title_cn: Artificial Intelligence and the Ethics and Practice of Evaluation

title: Open-Weight AI Models May Increase Biological Misuse Risks: Assessing Anti-Refusal Tampering, Capability Enhancement, and Publicly Available Uncensored Models
summary_en: Open-weight LLMs can be modified by users, creating benefits but also biosecurity risks. We find that removing an LLM’s safety training is feasible and may amplify realistic threat pathways, while enhancing an LLM’s biological capabilities is harder.
title_cn: Open-Weight AI Models May Increase Biological Misuse Risks: Assessing Anti-Refusal Tampering, Capability Enhancement, and Publicly Available Uncensored Models
